title: WantedPlayer
description: WANTED PLAYER plugin for SMP and Private servers
body:
# WantedPlayer 🤠
A dynamic bounty and team-based criminal justice system designed for modern Minecraft servers. Perfect for SMPs, Semi-Vanilla, and Factions looking to add a natural PvP risk-and-reward layer without cluttering the gameplay!

---

## 🌟 Key Features

### 🤠 Dynamic Wanted & Bounty System
*   **Become a Criminal:** Killing a player immediately places a **WANTED** status on your head and sets a starting bounty.
*   **Rising Stakes:** Getting more kills while already wanted increases your bounty further, making you a highly lucrative target for everyone on the server!
*   **Bounty Hunting:** Hunt down wanted players to claim their bounty and earn direct rewards (default: custom diamond payout!).
*   **Spawn-Killing & Farm Protection:** Includes an anti-exploit threshold where a victim must have a minimum playtime (configurable, e.g., 2 hours) before their death triggers a "wanted" status on their killer.

### ⚖️ Moral Points & Villager Discounts
*   **Play the Hero:** Killing a wanted criminal awards you **Moral Points** for doing justice.
*   **Earn Discounts:** Accumulating Moral Points earns you permanent or active discounts with Villagers. 
*   **Easy to Use:** Simply **Sneak + Click** a villager to automatically apply your discount tier! View your points at any time using `/moral`.

### 👥 Advanced Team System
*   **Form Alliances:** Create teams and invite your friends to survive the bounty hunters or rule the server together.
*   **Coordinated Defense:** Set custom team home locations (`/team sethome` & `/team home`) to quickly regroup.
*   **Private Channels:** Communicate instantly and safely with your teammates using private `/teamchat` (`/tc`).

---

## 💻 Commands & Permissions

Here is a cheat sheet of all available commands and their respective permissions:

| Command | Description | Default Permission |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/wanted` | View all currently active wanted players and their current bounties. | `wantedplayer.wanted` (Everyone) |
| `/moral` | Check your current Moral Points and active Villager discount tier. | `wantedplayer.moral` (Everyone) |
| `/playtime` | View your exact total playtime on the server. | `wantedplayer.playtime` (Everyone) |
| `/team <create\|invite\|accept\|leave\|kick\|info>` | Complete suite of commands for team management. | `wantedplayer.team` (Everyone) |
| `/team <sethome\|home\|delhome\|homes>` | Set, delete, list, or teleport to your private team homes. | `wantedplayer.team` (Everyone) |
| `/teamchat [message]` | Toggle team chat mode or send a private message (aliases: `/tc`). | `wantedplayer.team` (Everyone) |
| `/unwanted <player>` | **(Admin)** Instantly remove a player's wanted status and active bounty. | `wantedplayer.admin` (Operators) |

---

## ⚙️ Fully Configurable (`config.yml`)
You can fully customize every aspect of the plugin to fit your server's economy and theme:
*   **Custom Rewards:** Set the number of diamonds (or other materials) rewarded per bounty claim.
*   **Smart Cooldowns:** Add a cooldown duration before a player can become wanted again.
*   **Protection Rules:** Set the minimum victim playtime requirement to protect new players.
*   **Custom Broadcasts:** Fully customize messages, prefixes, and color codes for when players become wanted, bounties increase, or bounties are claimed.
*   **Moral Math:** Fine-tune how many moral points are awarded, how many points are needed per discount tier, and the maximum emerald discount allowed.
